(1 comment)

Experimental feature testing in progress, please pay attention to the comments

Looks good. The two real compat mechanisms are correct: the folio_batch.h shim plus the LC_HAVE_FOLIO_BATCH_HEADER test (which re-provides HAVE_FOLIO_BATCH/HAVE_FOLIO_BATCH_REINIT, since the existing tests include the now-removed linux/pagevec.h), the FOLIO_BATCH_SIZE conversions, and the DENTRY_D_ALIAS autoconf test are all sound and the conversions are complete (no stray d_u.d_alias/PAGEVEC_SIZE remain). One minor commit-message note inline.
Hashtag added: master-next
